name: Performance Subdomain
body:
Associated Domain: Art

Replacement Power: The following granted power replaces the artist’s touch power of the art domain.

Inspiring Performance (Su)

Your performances spur your allies to greater heights. You gain use of the inspire courage bardic performance using your cleric level as your effective bard level for its effects. You may create this performance effect for a number of rounds equal to half your cleric level plus your Charisma modifier (minimum 1). However, the rounds you are able to perform in a given day are shared between this ability and the fascination part of the enthralling art ability gained at 8th level. As with the enthralling art ability, if you subsequently take levels in a class with the inspire courage ability, the cleric levels stack with that class of its effects. This domain ability does not stack with any archetype that provides bardic performances (like the evangelist).

Replacement Domain Spells: 2nd–allegro, 3rd–thundering drums, 9th–overwhelming presence
